quote: Components and products similar to those we make can be produced by competitors using either the same types of manufacturing processes or other forms of manufacturing.
why: 『can be produced by competitors』と競合の代替生産を明記。長期契約の記述はあるが発注は顧客が解約でき、乗換費用の記述なし

quote: Competition is based primarily on quarry or distribution location and price, but quality of aggregates and level of customer service are also factors.
why: 『location and price』で競争すると明記し、顧客の乗換費用の記述なし。長期契約は新設の石灰窯1基分のみ

quote: We provide the infrastructure for an Internet presence that extends to tens of thousands of customers who have integrated the Company tools directly into their own web sites.
why: 数万の顧客が当社ツールを『integrated』し『their own web sites』へ組込済と断定。業務への組込の名指しで、再認定の記述はない

quote: Our industry is highly competitive, with competition based primarily on customer service, price, store location and appearance, and quality, availability and assortment of merchandise.
why: 『highly competitive』で価格・立地・品揃えで競う小売。顧客の乗換費用の機構の名指しはない

quote: Our stations compete for listeners and advertising revenue with other radio stations within their respective markets.
why: 『compete for listeners and advertising revenue』と同業局と競う一般的記述。広告主の乗換費用の記述なし

quote: There are currently no approved drugs other than Soliris for the treatment of PNH and aHUS.
why: 『no approved drugs other than』と唯一の承認薬だが、自社の承認による独占で顧客の乗換費用の機構ではない

quote: The marketplace for sporting goods is highly fragmented as many different retailers compete for market share by utilizing a variety of store formats and merchandising strategies.
why: 『highly fragmented』『many different retailers compete』の一般的な競争記述のみ。乗換費用の記述なし

quote: Over the past three years, our annual renewal rate of customers subscribing to comprehensive support and enhancements has been greater than 90%.
mech: 解約率・更新率の実数
why: 保守契約の『annual renewal rate』が『greater than 90%』と更新率の実数を断定。顧客側の再認定の記述はない

quote: Our customers have no obligation to renew their agreements for our services after the expiration of their existing terms, which are typically 12 to 24 months.
why: 『no obligation to renew』『typically 12 to 24 months』と更新義務なしを明記。最低利用の約定も複数年ではない

quote: The sale of women’s intimate and other apparel, personal care and beauty products and accessories through retail stores is a highly competitive business with numerous competitors, including individual and chain specialty stores, department stores and discount retailers.
why: 『highly competitive business with numerous competitors』の一般的な競争記述のみ。乗換費用の記述なし

quote: The license and maintenance agreements that contribute to subscription and maintenance bookings represent binding payment commitments by customers over periods that range generally from three to five years, although in certain cases customer commitments can be for longer or shorter periods.
why: 『binding payment commitments』が『three to five years』と複数年の購買義務を断定。再認定の記述はない

quote: We do not have long-term sales contracts with any of our customers.
why: 『do not have long-term sales contracts』と長期契約なしを明記し、顧客は購入をやめられると続く。乗換費用の記述なし
